exact_preorder: lambda=0 PRECEDES lambda=-1 PRECEDES lambda=-2 PRECEDES every lambda outside {0,-1,-2}, where PRECEDES means no larger causal closure for any N and strictly smaller as a response law
hit_time_function: tau(lambda)=1-lambda for lambda in {-2,-1,0}; tau(lambda)=INFINITY otherwise
invariant_order: the phase first-hit preorder is invariantly defined by which current ingress phase the parameter predicate selects and by its first occurrence from p0=0
ordinary_signed_integer_order: NOT_CLAIMED; a harmless parameter relabeling changes numeric ordering, so ordinary lambda magnitude/order is a PARAMETERIZATION_ARTIFACT
response_formula: P_lambda(N,q)=min(N,tau(lambda)+1) when tau finite; P_lambda=N when tau infinite
strict_integer_order: for every N>=5,q>=2: P_0=2 < P_-1=3 < P_-2=4 < P_lambda=N for all unmatched lambda
